title: Blind Dexterous Grasping via Real2Sim2Real Tactile Policy Learning
title_zh: 基于 Real2Sim2Real 触觉策略学习的无视觉灵巧抓取
abstract: Blind grasping with a dexterous hand is a crucial manipulation capability. Nevertheless, learning such tactile-only policies for real robots remains challenging due to the tactile sim-to-real gap and the limited expressiveness of sparse tactile signals. To bridge this gap, we propose a framework for tactile-only blind grasping that is deployable on a physical multi-fingered robotic hand. Our approach combines three key components. editorial.selection_reason: Solid Real2Sim2Real framework for blind tactile grasping. Three-component approach (calibration, layout-aware encoder, Diffusion Policy) is well-motivated. Real robot deployment on LEAP Hand with 44-channel tactile sensing across 20 objects. 27% real-world success without vision is a meaningful baseline for tactile-only grasping. Fills tactile-only policy learning gap on the board.
